analyst_view.overall: A mid-table Segunda game at Butarque: Leganés (15th, 18 points) against Sabadell (14th, 19 points), with both about four points above the drop zone. Luis Carrión's Leganés have won three in a row, the last 3-1 at Andorra on 20 November, but Álvaro Morata, who scored and assisted there, went off in the 70th minute with discomfort; FotMob lists him injured, while the club gave no diagnosis, so he is a doubt. Sabadell have drawn a lot (7 of 15), score little (13 goals) and are without forward Nicholas Gioacchini, out for the season per FotMob. The numbers carry no player list for this game and already add a lot for both sides' recent bookings; no referee is named yet. My only move is a small trim to goals and shots on target for the Morata doubt.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.9 goals, 1.0 for Leganés. Morata has been Leganés' main attacking reference and left the Andorra game hurt; the numbers do not know about it, and Sabadell are a low-scoring, draw-heavy side, so I trim a little to about 1.8. If Morata is cleared this goes back to the numbers.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners, split evenly. Both teams have been near their usual corner counts lately and the numbers add a little for it; a striker doubt does not change the wide play much, so I stay at about 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.6 cards, already high because Leganés (27 in six) and Sabadell have both been booked a lot recently and the numbers add 11-16% each for it. No referee is named yet and there is no derby edge, so I stay at about 6.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots, 14.9 for Sabadell, who have been allowed plenty of shots by Leganés' defence lately (104 conceded in six), which the numbers already count. Without Morata Leganés may shoot a bit less, but the volume comes more from the run of play than from him, so I stay at about 26.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target, 4.3 for Leganés, whose recent accuracy (33 on target in six) the numbers already boost. Much of that came through Morata, who is a doubt after going off at Andorra, so I trim slightly to about 7.7.
